answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in ripple, checked in thread, and forge shows each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 8 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 2735 identities would post 1181 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
